assertions.assertion: The appeal is for a CO-97 denial
Cornerstone United determined the service was bundled into another covered procedure and not separately payable
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9)
The patient reports intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The symptoms are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
The cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other intermittent dysrhythmias
The service is distinct and separately indicated
